message.content: Introducing "Lumina Tide," a holiday celebrating the ocean's bioluminescent glow, observed on the night of the first new moon in June. Traditions include families gathering on beaches to release hand-painted, floating lanterns shaped like sea creatures, each carrying a written wish for the coming season. As the lanterns drift on the dark water, participants share a communal "silent chorus," humming together in harmony to mimic the peaceful pulse of the glowing waves.
